summary: Mother and her 14-year-old son lost overnight on a hike between Trappers Lake and Stillwater Reservoir after getting turned around; husband/father searched that night with friends, a cell-phone ping gave approximate coordinates, and he spotted them and called 911 the next morning; mother treated for hypothermia and dehydration at Trappers Lake, son uninjured
location: between Trappers Lake and Stillwater Reservoir
responding_agency: Garfield County SAR; Garfield County Sheriff's Office; Routt County Sheriff's Office SAR volunteers; CareFlight of the Rockies
